the AKN turbulence model is the best model for the prediction of turbulent mixed convection in the heated vertical tube of supercritical water.

the AKN and CH models are able to reproduce the overall trend of heat transfer deterioration and recovery of supercritical water, and the CH model is able to predict heat transfer deterioration and heat transfer recovery of supercritical flow with a better accuracy.
